instructions.name: ActivateRobot
instructions.description: Activate all motors and release the joint brakes.

params.name: e
params.description: Force a re-initialization of the drives (1). Homing is then required again.

instructions.remarks: The manual gives no syntax block for this command; the optional argument is described in its Arguments section.

instructions.name: ActivateSim
instructions.description: Activate simulation mode, in which no hardware moves.

params.name: m
params.description: Integer specifying the simulation mode type as 0, disabled (equivalent to using the command DeactivateSim), 1, normal (real-time) simulation mode, 2, fast simulation mode.

instructions.name: ClearMotion
instructions.description: Stop the robot movement in the same fashion as the PauseMotion command (i.e., by decelerating).

instructions.name: ConnectionWatchdog
instructions.description: Start or refresh the communication watchdog, or cancel it with a timeout of zero.

params.name: t
params.description: Desired timeout period, in seconds, ranging from 0.001 to (2³² − 2)/1000. If the argument is zero, the connection watchdog is canceled.

instructions.name: CreateVariable
instructions.description: Create a variable that is saved on the robot and optionally persists even after a reboot.

params.name: name
params.description: A unique name for this variable (e.g., “myVar”); Variable names are case sensitive; May include several case-sensitive prefixes (e.g., “myGroup.mySubgroup.mainWrf”); If the name already exists, the behavior of CreateVariable depends on the override argument.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to assign to the variable; The value can be any basic JSON type: boolean, number, string, or array (but not a JSON object). Remember that in JSON syntax, boolean values must be lowercase (i.e., true or false). Examples: a boolean: CreateVariable(myBoolVar, true) a number: CreateVariable(myIntVar, -0.153) a string: CreateVariable(myStringVar, "Hello world!") an array: CreateVariable(myArrayVar, [190.0, 0.0, 308.9, 0, 90, 0])

params.name: cyclicId
params.description: The unique ID used to refer to this variable in cyclic protocols in the range [10000,19999] or 0; When 0 (or omitted), no cyclic ID is associated with the variable; If the provided cyclic ID is already in use, CreateVariable will fail with error [1552]; If a non-zero cyclic ID is used, the value must be a number or an array of numbers, otherwise CreateVariable will fail with error [1552].

params.name: override
params.description: Specifies how CreateVariable behaves when a variable with the same name already exists: 0 to return the error [1552] if the existing variable has a different type or cyclic ID; otherwise do nothing and leave the variable unchanged; 1 to update the existing variable’s value and cyclic ID with the new ones.

params.name: volatile
params.description: Specifies whether the variable is volatile (1) or persistent (0): 0: the variable is persistent and saved on the robot disk. It remains available after a reboot; 1: the variable is volatile and is not saved on the robot disk. It is discarded on reboot.

instructions.remarks: Beta feature. Variable names are case-sensitive and may carry dot-separated prefixes.

instructions.name: DeactivateRobot
instructions.description: Disable all motors (as well as the EOAT connected to the tool I/O port) and engages the brakes on the robot joints.

instructions.name: DeactivateSim
instructions.description: Deactivate simulation mode.

instructions.name: Delay
instructions.description: Add a time delay after a motion command.

params.name: t
params.description: Desired pause duration in seconds.

instructions.name: DeleteVariable
instructions.description: Delete a variable from the robot.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the variable to delete (e.g., “myVar”).

instructions.name: EnableEtherNetIp
instructions.description: Enable or disable EtherNet/IP slave stack, allowing the robot to be controlled or monitored by an EtherNetIP controller.

params.name: e
params.description: EtherNet/IP mode setting. The possible values are: 0: EtherNet/IP disabled; 1: EtherNet/IP enabled; 2: EtherNet/IP enabled in monitoring mode only.

instructions.name: EnableProfinet
instructions.description: Enable or disable the PROFINET slave stack, allowing the robot to be controlled or monitored by a PROFINET controller.

params.name: e
params.description: PROFINET mode setting. The possible values are: 0: PROFINET disabled; 1: PROFINET enabled; 2: PROFINET enabled in monitoring mode only.

instructions.name: GetAutoConf
instructions.description: Return the state of the automatic posture configuration selection, which can be influenced by the SetAutoConf and SetConf commands.

instructions.name: GetAutoConfTurn
instructions.description: Return the state of the automatic turn configuration selection, which can be influenced by the SetAutoConfTurn and SetConfTurn commands.

instructions.name: GetBlending
instructions.description: Return the blending percentage, which is set using the SetBlending command.

instructions.name: GetCalibrationCfg
instructions.description: Return the state of the optional robot calibration, configured using the SetCalibrationCfg command.

instructions.name: GetCartAcc
instructions.description: Return the desired limit for the acceleration of the Tool Reference Frame (TRF) relative to the World Reference Frame (WRF), set using the SetCartAcc command.

instructions.name: GetCartAngVel
instructions.description: Return the desired limit for the angular velocity of the Tool Reference Frame (TRF) relative to the World Reference Frame (WRF), set using the SetCartAngVel command.

instructions.name: GetCartLinVel
instructions.description: Return the desired Tool Center Point (TCP) velocity limit, configured using the SetCartLinVel command.

instructions.name: GetCheckpoint
instructions.description: Return the argument of the last executed SetCheckpoint.

instructions.name: GetCheckpointDiscarded
instructions.description: Return the id of the most recently discarded checkpoint.

instructions.name: GetCmdPendingCount
instructions.description: Return the number of motion commands that are currently in the motion queue.

instructions.name: GetCollisionCfg
instructions.description: Return the severity level set with the SetCollisionCfg command.

instructions.name: GetCollisionStatus
instructions.description: Return the current collision status (refer to Figure 13).
instructions.remarks: The manual prints this command without parentheses. It is listed here with the empty argument list used by every other data request command.

instructions.name: GetConf
instructions.description: Return the desired posture configuration (see Section 2.2.1), or more precisely, the posture configuration that will be applied to the next MovePose or MoveLin* command in the motion queue.

instructions.name: GetConfTurn
instructions.description: Return the desired turn configuration for the last joint (see Section 2.2.1), i.e., the turn configuration that will be applied to the next MovePose or MoveLin* command in the motion queue.

instructions.name: GetEthernetIpEnabled
instructions.description: Return the state of the Ethernet/IP protocol.

instructions.name: GetExtToolFwVersion
instructions.description: Return the firmware version of Meca500’s EOAT connected to its tool I/O port.

instructions.name: GetExtToolSim
instructions.description: Return the emulation mode of the EOAT that can be connected to the tool port of the robot, normally set with the SetExtToolSim.

instructions.name: GetFwVersion
instructions.description: Return the version of the firmware installed on the robot.

instructions.name: GetGripperForce
instructions.description: Return the grip force set by the SetGripperForce command.

instructions.name: GetGripperRange
instructions.description: Return the gripper range set by the SetGripperRange command.

instructions.name: GetGripperVel
instructions.description: Return the gripper velocity set by the SetGripperVel command.

instructions.name: GetJointAcc
instructions.description: Return the desired joint accelerations reduction factor, set using the SetJointAcc command.

instructions.name: GetJointLimits
instructions.description: Return the current effective joint limits, i.e., the default joint limits or the user-defined limits if applied using the SetJointLimits command and enabled using the SetJointLimitsCfg command.

params.description: Joint number, an integer.

instructions.name: GetJointLimitsCfg
instructions.description: Return the status of the user-enabled joint limits, defined by the SetJointLimitsCfg.

instructions.name: GetJointVel
instructions.description: Return the desired joint velocities reduction factor, set using the SetJointVel command.

instructions.name: GetJointVelLimit
instructions.description: Return the desired joint velocities override, set using the SetJointVelLimit command.

instructions.name: GetModelJointLimits
instructions.description: Return the factory default joint limits.

params.name: n
params.description: Joint number, an integer.

instructions.name: GetMonitoringInterval
instructions.description: Return the time interval at which real-time feedback from the robot is sent over TCP port 10001, which is set using the SetMonitoringInterval command.

instructions.name: GetMoveDuration
instructions.description: Return the default duration set by the SetMoveDuration command.

instructions.name: GetMoveDurationCfg
instructions.description: Return the severity of the response when a move command cannot meet the desired duration set by the SetMoveDuration command, in time-based move mode.

instructions.name: GetMoveMode
instructions.description: Return the default move mode set by the SetMoveMode command.

instructions.name: GetNetworkOptions
instructions.description: Return the parameters affecting the network connection, which are set using the SetNetworkOptions command.

instructions.name: GetPayload
instructions.description: Return the configured payload mass and center of mass, as set using the SetPayload command.

instructions.name: GetProductType
instructions.description: Return the type (model) of the product.

instructions.name: GetProfinetEnabled
instructions.description: Return the state of the PROFINET protocol.

instructions.name: GetPStop2Cfg
instructions.description: Return the severity level set with the SetPStop2Cfg command.

instructions.name: GetRealTimeMonitoring
instructions.description: Return the numerical codes of the responses that have been enabled using the SetRealTimeMonitoring command.

instructions.name: GetRecoveryMode
instructions.description: Return whether the robot is in recovery mode or not as set by the command SetRecoveryMode.

instructions.name: GetRobotCalibrated
instructions.description: Return a response of 1 if the robot has undergone our optional calibration service, or 0 if it has not.

instructions.name: GetRobotName
instructions.description: Return the robot’s name, set with the command SetRobotName.

instructions.name: GetRobotSerial
instructions.description: Return the serial number of the robot, except for robots manufactured before 2021.

instructions.name: GetRtAccelerometer
instructions.description: Return the acceleration measured by the accelerometer embedded in link 5.

params.name: n
params.description: Link number, currently must be 5.

instructions.name: GetRtc
instructions.description: Return the current Epoch Time in seconds, set using the SetRtc, after every reboot of the robot.

instructions.name: GetRtCartPos
instructions.description: Return the pose of the TRF with respect to the WRF, as calculated from the current joint set read by the joint encoders.

instructions.name: GetRtCartVel
instructions.description: Return the current Cartesian velocity vector of the TRF with respect to the WRF, as calculated from the real-time data coming from the joint encoders.

instructions.name: GetRtConf
instructions.description: Return the current posture configuration, calculated from real-time data.

instructions.name: GetRtConfTurn
instructions.description: Return the current turn configuration, calculated from real-time data.

instructions.name: GetRtExtToolStatus
instructions.description: Return the general status of the external tool connected to the I/O port of the Meca500, preceded with a timestamp.

instructions.name: GetRtGripperForce
instructions.description: Return the currently applied grip force of the MEGP 25* grippers, preceded by a timestamp.

instructions.name: GetRtGripperPos
instructions.description: Return the current fingers opening (also referred to as gripper position) of the MEGP 25* grippers (see MoveGripper), preceded with a timestamp.

instructions.name: GetRtGripperState
instructions.description: Return the current state of the MEGP 25* grippers connected to the I/O port of the Meca500, preceded with a timestamp.

instructions.name: GetRtJointPos
instructions.description: Return the current joint set read by the joint encoders.

instructions.name: GetRtJointTorq
instructions.description: Return the current joint torques, or more specifically, the current motor torques.

instructions.name: GetRtJointVel
instructions.description: Return the current joint velocities, calculated by differentiating the joint encoders data.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetCartPos
instructions.description: Return the current target pose of the TRF relative to the WRF, rather than the pose derived from real-time data provided by the joint encoders.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetCartVel
instructions.description: Return the current target Cartesian velocity vector of the TRF with respect to the WRF.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetConf
instructions.description: Return the posture configuration parameters calculated from the current target joint set.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetConfTurn
instructions.description: Return the turn configuration parameters calculated from the current target joint value for the last joint.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetJointPos
instructions.description: Return the current target joint set.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetJointTorq
instructions.description: Return the current target (calculated) motor torques.

instructions.name: GetRtTargetJointVel
instructions.description: Return the current target joint velocities.

instructions.name: GetRtTrf
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the TRF with respect to the FRF, set by the SetTrf command.

instructions.name: GetRtValveState
instructions.description: Return the current state of the MPM500 pneumatic module connected to the I/O port of the Meca500, preceded with a timestamp.

instructions.name: GetRtWrf
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the WRF with respect to the BRF, set by the SetWrf command.

instructions.name: GetSafetyStopStatus
instructions.description: Return the status of specific safety stop signals.

params.name: n
params.description: Any of the following four-digit codes: 3032, for the state of the P-Stop 2 safety stop signal; 3070, for the state of the E-Stop safety stop signal; 3083, for the state of the safety stop signal associated with robot reboot or reset signal; 3086, for the state of the safety stop signal associated with a connection drop.

instructions.name: GetSimModeCfg
instructions.description: Return the default simulation mode set using the SetSimModeCfg command.

instructions.name: GetStatusRobot
instructions.description: Return the status of the robot.

instructions.name: GetTimeScaling
instructions.description: Return the time scaling percentage set using the SetTimeScaling command.

instructions.name: GetToolSphere
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the tool sphere, set with the SetToolSphere command.

instructions.name: GetTorqueLimits
instructions.description: Return the current joint torque thresholds.

instructions.name: GetTorqueLimitsCfg
instructions.description: Return the desired behavior of the robot when a joint torque exceeds the thresholds set by the SetTorqueLimits.

instructions.name: GetTorqueLimitsStatus
instructions.description: Return the status of the torque limits (whether a torque limit is currently exceeded).

instructions.name: GetTrf
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the TRF with respect to the FRF, set using the SetTrf command.

instructions.name: GetVariable
instructions.description: Return the value of a robot variable.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the variable to get (e.g., “myVar”).

instructions.name: GetVelTimeout
instructions.description: Return the timeout for velocity-mode motion commands, set using the SetVelTimeout command.

instructions.name: GetWorkZoneCfg
instructions.description: Return the current work zone configuration, set with the SetWorkZoneCfg command.

instructions.name: GetWorkZoneLimits
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the bounding box with respect to the BRF, set with the SetWorkZoneLimits command.

instructions.name: GetWorkZoneStatus
instructions.description: Return the current work zone violation status (refer to Figure 13).

instructions.name: GetWrf
instructions.description: Return the current definition of the WRF with respect to the BRF, set using the SetWrf command.

instructions.name: GripperClose

instructions.name: GripperOpen

params.name: s

instructions.name: SetAutoConf
instructions.description: Enable or disable automatic posture configuration selection, as used by the MovePose and MoveLin* commands.

params.name: e
params.description: Automatic posture configuration selection enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetAutoConfTurn
instructions.description: Enable or disable the automatic turn selection for the last joint of the robot (see Section 2.2.1 and Section 2.2.2).

params.name: e
params.description: Automatic turn configuration selection enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetBlending
instructions.description: Enable or disable the robot’s blending feature (Section 2.3.3).

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of blending, ranging from 0 (blending disabled) to 100.

instructions.name: SetCalibrationCfg
instructions.description: Enable or disable the robot's optional factory calibration.

params.name: e
params.description: Calibration enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetCartAcc
instructions.description: Limit the Cartesian acceleration (both linear and angular) of the TRF relative to the WRF during movements resulting from Cartesian-space commands (see Figure 11).

params.description: Percentage of maximum acceleration of the TRF, ranging from 0.001 to 600.

instructions.name: SetCartAngVel
instructions.description: Set the desired and maximum angular velocity of the robot TRF with respect to its WRF.

params.name: ω
params.description: TRF angular velocity limit, in °/s, ranging from 0.001 to 1,000.

instructions.name: SetCartLinVel

params.name: l
params.description: Integer defining the collision detection event severity as 0, silent (i.e., collisions are verified but no action is taken, other than to log them internally); 1, generate a warning (message [2182]) every time a new imminent collision is detected; 4, generate a warning (message [2182]) and a motion error (message [3041]) every time a new imminent collision is detected.

instructions.description: Set the desired posture configuration to be observed in the MovePose and MoveLin* commands (see Section 2.2.1 and Section 2.2.2).

instructions.name: SetConfTurn

params.name: e

params.description: Percentage of maximum grip force (~40 N), ranging from 5 to 100.

instructions.name: SetGripperRange
instructions.description: Set the closed and open states of the gripper and is used mainly to redefine the actions of the GripperClose and GripperOpen commands, respectively.

params.name: dclosed
params.description: Fingers opening that should correspond to closed state, in mm.

params.name: dopen
params.description: Fingers opening that should correspond to open state, in mm.

instructions.name: SetGripperVel
instructions.description: Limit the velocity of the gripper fingers (with respect to the gripper).

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of maximum finger velocity (~50 mm/s), ranging from 5 to 100.†

instructions.name: SetJointAcc
instructions.description: Limit the acceleration of the joints during movements resulting from joint-space commands (see Figure 11).

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of maximum acceleration of the joints, from 0.001 to 150.

instructions.name: SetJointLimits
instructions.description: Redefine the lower and upper limits of a robot joint.

params.name: n
params.description: Joint number, an integer.

params.name: qn
params.description: Upper joint limit, in degrees.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower joint limit, in degrees.

params.name: qn
params.description: Upper joint limit, in degrees.

params.name: max
params.description: Upper joint limit, in degrees.

instructions.name: SetJointLimitsCfg
instructions.description: Enable or disable the user-defined limits set by the SetJointLimits command.

params.name: e
params.description: User-defined joint limits enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetJointVel
instructions.description: Specify the desired velocities of the robot joints during movements generated by the MovePose, MoveJoints, and MoveJointsRel commands.

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of the R3 top rated joint velocities.

instructions.remarks: The upper bound depends on the robot revision: 100 on a Meca500 R3, 150 on an R4. The wider bound is used here so that R4 programs are not flagged.

instructions.name: SetJointVelLimit
instructions.description: Override the default upper bound on joint velocities.

params.name: p
params.description: Percentage of the R3 top rated joint velocities.

instructions.remarks: The upper bound depends on the robot revision: 100 on a Meca500 R3, 150 on an R4. The wider bound is used here so that R4 programs are not flagged. Unlike SetJointVel, this acts as a ceiling rather than a target.

instructions.name: SetMonitoringInterval
instructions.description: Set the time interval at which real-time feedback from the robot is sent from the robot over TCP port 10001 (see the description for SetRealTimeMonitoring and Table 3 for more details).

params.name: t
params.description: Desired time interval, in seconds, ranging from 0.001 to 1.

instructions.name: SetMoveDuration
instructions.description: Set the duration of every subsequent position-mode movement, in time-based move mode.

params.name: t
params.description: Duration in seconds.

instructions.name: SetMoveDurationCfg
instructions.description: Specify what happens when a move command cannot meet the desired duration set by the SetMoveDuration command, in time-based move mode.

params.name: s
params.description: Severity, with 0 for silent mode (no warning), 1 for generating a warning message in the robot logs (also in MecaPortal), indicating the shortest possible duration for the movement command that failed to meet the desired duration, 4 for generating an error with a code [3051], also indicating the shortest possible duration for the movement command that failed to meet the desired duration.

instructions.name: SetMoveMode
instructions.description: Select whether position-mode movements are timed by velocity or by duration.

params.name: m
params.description: Move sub-mode, where 0 stands for the velocity-based sub-mode, meaning the commands SetJointVel, SetCartLinVel, and SetCartAngVel affect all subsequent position-mode movement commands. 1 stands for the time-based submode, meaning the command SetMoveDuration affects all subsequent position-mode movement commands, except MoveJump.

instructions.name: SetNetworkOptions
instructions.description: Set persistent parameters affecting the network connection.

params.name: n
params.description: An integer ranging from 0 to 60 that defines the TCP keep-alive connection timeout in seconds, specifying how long the robot waits for client replies before terminating the connection; setting this value to 0 disables the keep-alive feature entirely, which may result in significantly delayed detection of connection failures.

instructions.name: SetOfflineProgramLoop
instructions.description: Set whether the program being saved runs once or indefinitely.

params.name: e
params.description: Loop execution enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetPayload
instructions.description: Set the robot’s payload mass and the center of mass relative to the robot’s FRF.

params.name: m
params.description: The payload mass, in kilograms.

params.name: cx
params.description: The coordinates of the payload center of mass, relative to the robot’s FRF, in millimeters.

params.name: cy
params.description: The coordinates of the payload center of mass, relative to the robot’s FRF, in millimeters.

params.name: cz
params.description: The coordinates of the payload center of mass, relative to the robot’s FRF, in millimeters.

instructions.name: SetPStop2Cfg
instructions.description: Set the behavior of the robot when the SWStop signal in the Meca500 R4 is activated.

params.name: l
params.description: Severity 2, for PauseMotion. Robot motion is paused but commands in the motion queue remain queued. New commands can be queued. 3, for ClearMotion. Robot motion is paused and all commands in the motion queue are cleared. The robot will refuse to add any new commands in the motion queue until the P-Stop 2 condition is reset using ResumeMotion.

instructions.name: SetRealTimeMonitoring
instructions.description: Select which real-time data sets are transmitted over the monitoring port.

params.name: n
params.description: A data set, given either as a number code (for example 2201) or by name (for example TargetCartPos). Use All to enable every data set.

instructions.name: SetRecoveryMode
instructions.description: Enable or disable recovery mode.

params.name: e
params.description: Recovery mode enabled (1) or disabled (0).

instructions.name: SetRobotName
instructions.description: Allow you to change the robot’s name.

params.name: s
params.description: String containing the robot’s name. It should contain a maximum of 63 characters, alphanumeric or hyphens, but should not start with a hyphen.

instructions.name: SetRtc
instructions.description: Set the robot's internal real-time clock.

params.name: t
params.description: Epoch time as defined in Unix (i.e., number of seconds since 00:00:00 UTC January 1, 1970).

instructions.name: SetSimModeCfg
instructions.description: Set the default simulation mode type used when ActivateSim is called without an argument.

params.name: m
params.description: Integer specifying the default simulation mode type 1, normal (real-time) simulation mode, 2, fast simulation mode.

instructions.name: SetTimeScaling
instructions.description: Set the time scaling of the trajectory generator.

params.name: p
params.description: Time scaling percentage, from 0.001 to 100.

instructions.name: SetToolSphere
instructions.description: Define a sphere fixed in the Flange Reference Frame (FRF).

params.name: x
params.description: The coordinates of the center of the tool sphere in the FRF, in mm.

params.name: y
params.description: The coordinates of the center of the tool sphere in the FRF, in mm.

params.name: z
params.description: The coordinates of the center of the tool sphere in the FRF, in mm.

params.name: r
params.description: The radius of the tool sphere, in mm.

instructions.name: SetTorqueLimits
instructions.description: Set thresholds for the torques applied to each motor, as percentages of the maximum allowable torques that can be applied at each motor.

params.name: τ1
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

params.name: τ2
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

params.name: τ3
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

params.name: τ4
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

params.name: τ5
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

params.name: τ6
params.description: Τi: torque threshold represented by a percentage of the maximum allowable torque that can be applied at motor i, where i = 1, 2, …, 6 ranging from 0.001 to 100.

instructions.name: SetTorqueLimitsCfg
instructions.description: Set the robot behavior when a joint torque exceeds the threshold set by the SetTorqueLimits command.

params.name: s
params.description: L: integer for the torque limit event severity 0, no action; 1, torque status event (message [3028]); 2, pause motion and torque status event (message [3028]); 4, torque status event (message [3028]) and torque limit error (message [3029]).

params.name: m
params.description: Integer defining the detection mode 0 triggers a torque limit if the absolute value of any actual motor torque exceeds the respective torque limit set with SetTorqueLimits, 1 is same as 0, but ignores joint acceleration/deceleration periods, 2 triggers if any actual motor torque deviates from the corresponding calculated torque by more than the respective torque limit set with SetTorqueLimits. See the note below concerning accuracy of torque prediction.

instructions.name: SetTrf
instructions.description: Define the pose of the TRF with respect to the FRF.

params.name: x
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the TRF with respect to the FRF, in mm.

params.name: y
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the TRF with respect to the FRF, in mm.

params.name: z
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the TRF with respect to the FRF, in mm.

params.name: α
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the TRF relative to the FRF, in degrees.

params.name: β
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the TRF relative to the FRF, in degrees.

params.name: γ
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the TRF relative to the FRF, in degrees.

instructions.name: SetValveState
instructions.description: Control each of the two valves in the MPM500 pneumatic module independently.

params.name: v1
params.description: Open (1), close (0), or keep unchanged (−1 or *) valve 1.

params.name: v2
params.description: Open (1), close (0), or keep unchanged (−1 or *) valve 2.

instructions.name: SetVariable
instructions.description: Modify a robot variable.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable to modify (e.g., “myVar”).

params.name: value
params.description: The new value to assign to the variable; The value can be any basic JSON type: boolean, number, string, or array (but not a JSON object). Remember that in JSON syntax, boolean values must be lowercase (i.e., true or false); SetVariable will fail with error [1554] if you try to assign a value of a different type or array length. Examples: a boolean: SetVariable(myBoolVar, true) a number: SetVariable(myIntVar, -0.153) a string: SetVariable(myStringVar, "Hello world!") an array: SetVariable(myArrayVar, [190.0, 0.0, 308.9, 0, 90, 0])

instructions.remarks: Beta feature. A variable's value can only be changed to a value of the same type.

instructions.name: SetVelTimeout
instructions.description: Define the timeout period following a velocity-mode motion command (MoveJointsVel, MoveLinVelTrf, or MoveLinVelWrf).

params.name: t
params.description: Desired timeout period, in seconds, ranging from 0.001 to 1.

instructions.name: SetWorkZoneCfg
instructions.description: Specify the “event severity” for the work zone limits supervision and the robot parts that need to be verified.

params.name: l
params.description: Integer defining the work zone breach detection event severity as 0: silent (i.e., work zone breach is verified but no action is taken, other than to log them internally); 1: generate a warning (message [2183]) every time a new imminent work zone breach is detected; 4: generate a warning (message [2183]) and a motion error (message [3049]) every time a new imminent work zone breach is detected.

params.name: m
params.description: Integer defining the work zone breach verification mode as 1: verify whether the FCP (Flange Center Point) is inside the work zone; 2: verify whether the tool is completely inside the work zone (tool is the tool sphere defined with the SetToolSphere command, and the MPM500 module if detected on the Meca500); 3: verify whether the tool AND all robot links are completely inside the work zone.

instructions.name: SetWorkZoneLimits
instructions.description: Define a bounding box (a cuboid), the sides of which are parallel to the axes of the Base Reference Frame (BRF).

params.name: xmin
params.description: The coordinates of the minimum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

params.name: ymin
params.description: The coordinates of the minimum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

params.name: zmin
params.description: The coordinates of the minimum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

params.name: xmax
params.description: The coordinates of the maximum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

params.name: ymax
params.description: The coordinates of the maximum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

params.name: zmax
params.description: The coordinates of the maximum corner of the cuboid in the BRF, in mm.

instructions.name: SetWrf
instructions.description: Define the pose of the WRF with respect to the BRF.

params.name: x
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the WRF with respect to the BRF, in mm.

params.name: y
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the WRF with respect to the BRF, in mm.

params.name: z
params.description: The coordinates of the origin of the WRF with respect to the BRF, in mm.

params.name: α
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the WRF relative to the BRF, in degrees.

params.name: β
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the WRF relative to the BRF, in degrees.

params.name: γ
params.description: Euler angles representing the orientation of the WRF relative to the BRF, in degrees.

instructions.name: StartProgram
instructions.description: Start a program that has been previously saved in the robot’s memory.

params.name: s
params.description: String containing the program name. It should contain a maximum of 63 characters among the 62 alphanumerical characters (A..Z, a..z, 0..9), the underscore and the hyphen.

instructions.name: StartSaving
instructions.description: Save commands in the robot’s internal memory.

params.name: n
params.description: Program number, where n ≤ 500 (maximum number of programs that can be stored).

instructions.name: StopSaving
instructions.description: Save the program being recorded and stop saving.

instructions.name: SwitchToEtherCat
instructions.description: Enable EtherCAT and disable the other Ethernet-based protocols.

instructions.name: SyncCmdQueue
instructions.description: Insert a synchronization marker in the response stream.

instructions.name: TcpDump
instructions.description: Start an Ethernet capture (PCAP file format) on the robot, for the specified duration.

instructions.name: TcpDumpStop
instructions.description: Stop a TCP dump before its timeout elapses.
